title: Lean verification of the Riemann Hypothesis

quotes.text: We hereby certify that both the statement and the proof of the Riemann Hypothesis are correct.
quotes.for: The communities certify both the theorem statement and its proof.

quotes.text: The checkers con-leche and con-ron come with a formal proof, relative to set theory, that they cannot accept a false proof
quotes.for: Two of the proof checkers carry a formal proof that they cannot accept a false proof.

title: Verification files for the Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis

quotes.text: The published Lean source compiles without errors, the five headline theorems depend only on the three standard axioms

title: Likely solution to Riemann hypothesis by AI marks turning point for mathematics

quotes.text: It wouldn't have any practical implications (at least not immediately)

title: “…and the proof is checked in Lean”

quotes.text: there is an important signal that can be extracted from Lean code, but if this code is AI-generated then you need to do some tests first
quotes.for: The Xena post explains how to read claims that a theorem was checked in Lean.

quotes.text: Lean now has many kernels, created by users, written in many different languages
quotes.for: Independent kernels reduce the risk that a Lean kernel bug could hide a false proof.
